sources.text: Apply for an older person's bus pass If you live in England or Wales In England you can get a bus pass for free travel when you reach the State Pension age . If you live in London, you can travel free on buses, tubes and other transport when you’re 60, but only within London. In Wales you can get a bus pass when you reach 60. Enter your postcode to: apply for a bus pass from your local council check if you can get one sooner Enter a postcode For example SW1A 2AA Find your local council Find a postcode on Royal Mail's postcode finder If you live in Scotland or Northern Ireland You get an older person’s bus pass when you’re 60.
